title: dryopteris filix-mas subsp. paleacea
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. paleacea, commonly known as pale-crested male fern, is a subspecies of the male fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. paleacea include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of these compounds.
